items.title: Moderna Soared 8% on Cancer Data. Friday’s Report Shows Whether It Can Afford the Pipeline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna stock jumped 13% on Wednesday to a new 52-week high on early multiple myeloma data and an Ebola vaccine recommendation, then gave back 5% on Thursday ahead of Friday’s report. Pfizer’s Comirnaty sales fell 29% operationally in the third quarter, and BioNTech’s revenue fell 15%.
